event_name: Rich Energy Haas F1 Team Document 18 Date 07 June 2019 Time 19:02 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 11) heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Car 20 went to the right of the bollard at turn 14 contrary to the Race Directors Note no 9.1 (document 2).
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 20 (Kevin Magnussen) and the team representative. The Driver of Car 20 has not followed the Race Director's Note no 9.1, which requires the Cars overshooting the chicane in Turn 14 to drive around the bollard prior to rejoining the Track. However, in trying to do that, given the circumstances of the incident, it would have been difficult to achieve. The Stewards acknowledge that the Driver of Car 20 slowed sufficiently and re-joined the Track in a safe manner. Furthermore, given the offence was committed during Free Practice 2, no sporting advantage was gained.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 20 Re Joining The Track
